queries.query: Does information have to be marked confidential (or confirmed in writing) for the agreement to protect it?
queries.expected_answer_or_key_facts: nda_493 and nda_65 protect written material only if marked confidential, and oral disclosures only if reduced to writing within 15/10 days; nda_25 and nda_539 protect information regardless of marking.

queries.query: How long do the confidentiality obligations last?
queries.expected_answer_or_key_facts: nda_25 is a three-year term plus two years' survival; nda_493 is two years after the last disclosure; nda_539 is eighteen months; nda_65 is two years after the one-year Initial Term (indefinite for trade secrets). Incompatible.

queries.query: If we are legally compelled to disclose the confidential information, must we notify the other party first?
queries.expected_answer_or_key_facts: All three require notice before compelled disclosure; they agree. nda_25 simply carves legally-required disclosure out of the obligation with no notice duty.

queries.query: Does the recipient have to return or destroy the confidential information on request?
queries.expected_answer_or_key_facts: All four require return or destruction on request; they agree. nda_539 and nda_65 permit limited retained legal/archival/backup copies.

queries.query: Can a party get an injunction to stop a breach without proving actual damages?
queries.expected_answer_or_key_facts: Both allow injunctive relief for breach; they agree. nda_65 expressly waives proof of actual damages. nda_25 has no remedies clause and nda_493 refers only generically to 'all remedies available under law'.

queries.query: Under the AdvanIDe agreement, what remedy does the disclosing party have for a breach of confidentiality?
queries.expected_answer_or_key_facts: nda_25 contains no remedies clause — no injunctive relief, no specific performance, no fee-shifting. The other three address remedies but do not speak to the AdvanIDe agreement.

queries.query: Do any of these agreements require disputes to be resolved by arbitration?
queries.expected_answer_or_key_facts: None mention arbitration. nda_25 (Singapore courts), nda_493 (Florida), nda_539 (New York courts) and nda_65 (Alberta courts) all point to litigation.

queries.query: Does each person who receives the confidential information have to sign a separate acknowledgement form?
queries.expected_answer_or_key_facts: Free-choice question. Only nda_65 requires each Permitted Recipient either to execute the Appendix A acknowledgement or to be bound in writing by no-less-restrictive terms. One document addressing the point is enough for 'answer'.
